categories.question: A park artist asks you to choose a horned dinosaur for a mural. Which do you pick?

outcomes.name: Triceratops
outcomes.description: Green ceratopsian with two brow horns and a short nose horn

outcomes.name: Styracosaurus
outcomes.description: Ceratopsian with large nose horn and long spikes around its frill

outcomes.name: Pachyrhinosaurus
outcomes.description: Sandy ceratopsian with broad bony nose boss

outcomes.name: Protoceratops
outcomes.description: Small hornless ceratopsian with a short neck frill

categories.question: The puppet theatre needs a dinosaur with a memorable silhouette. Which one stars?

outcomes.name: Stegosaurus
outcomes.description: Quadrupedal dinosaur with tall paired back plates

outcomes.name: Ankylosaurus
outcomes.description: Low armoured dinosaur with a large tail club

outcomes.name: Parasaurolophus
outcomes.description: Duck-billed dinosaur with long curved head crest

categories.question: You're directing an ancient-ocean documentary. Which reptile gets the opening shot?

outcomes.name: Plesiosaurus
outcomes.description: Long-necked marine reptile with four broad flippers

outcomes.name: Ichthyosaurus
outcomes.description: Dolphin-shaped marine reptile with long narrow toothed snout

outcomes.name: Mosasaurus
outcomes.description: Large streamlined marine lizard with long jaws

outcomes.name: Archelon
outcomes.description: Giant prehistoric sea turtle with expansive front flippers

categories.question: You open an illustrated ice age atlas. Which animal do you look up first?

outcomes.name: Woolly mammoth
outcomes.description: Shaggy brown mammoth with curved tusks

outcomes.name: Smilodon
outcomes.description: Golden saber-toothed cat with large curved canines

outcomes.name: Giant ground sloth
outcomes.description: Huge shaggy brown ground sloth standing upright

outcomes.name: Woolly rhinoceros
outcomes.description: Shaggy rhinoceros with long front horn
